system.description:
As part of the activation of this jutsu, you can only use this Taijutsu against a Prone target.

You perform a rather acrobatic display of skill. By kicking a Prone creature, you propel yourself backward while performing a second sweeping kick while moving away. Make two melee taijutsu attacks, on a hit you deal your [Unarmed damage] + 2d10. You then choose a space you can see within 20 Feet, leaping to that location, without triggering attacks of opportunity.

Finisher: you instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 4d10 and you regain your Bonus Action, if you’ve already spent it this turn..
